xhtml:body.xhtml:script: (async()=>{const base=new URL('./',location.href),status=document.getElementById('status');try{if(!isSecureContext||!navigator.serviceWorker)throw Error('HTTPS and service workers are required');const r=await navigator.serviceWorker.register(new URL('sw.js',base),{scope:base.pathname});await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;if(!navigator.serviceWorker.controller){status.textContent='Finishing secure setup…';await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const t=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('The browser did not activate Orbit’s service worker.')),10000);navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('controllerchange',()=>{clearTimeout(t);resolve()},{once:true})})}location.reload()}catch(e){status.textContent='Orbit could not start: '+String(e.message||e)}})();
